title: for loops
learningObjectives: Explain for loops and choose an appropriate control-flow structure.

understand.concept: A for loop repeats a block using an initialization expression, a condition, and an update expression. The condition is checked before each iteration. A loop variable can track the current index or count.
understand.whyItMatters: Loops reduce repeated code and help process collections. Ensure the update moves toward termination so the loop does not run forever.
understand.analogy: A for loop is a repeated set of steps with a starting point, a stopping condition, and a change after each pass.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; JavaScript control flow follows precise condition evaluation and iteration semantics.

explain.narrative: The loop logs Lesson 1 through Lesson 5. The update increments index after each iteration.

examples.explanation: The loop logs Lesson 1 through Lesson 5. The update increments index after each iteration.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser console displays the sequence or branch results described.

practise.guidedTask: Write a loop that totals the numbers from 1 through 10. Explain the initialization, condition, and update.
practise.independentTask: Write a small program that uses the control-flow structure to process learner or course data. Test normal, boundary, and empty cases.
hints: Use strict comparisons for exact values.
Choose for...of for iterable values and avoid confusing keys with values.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>for loops</title></head><body>
<script>for(let index=1;index<=5;index++){console.log('Lesson',index);}</script>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which part of a for loop is checked before each iteration?
questions.explanation: The loop condition is evaluated before the body on each iteration.

questions.prompt: What should you verify when writing a loop?
options: That its condition and updates allow it to terminate as intended
questions.answer: That its condition and updates allow it to terminate as intended
questions.explanation: Correct termination and boundary handling prevent infinite loops and skipped work.
